units.source_text: 这时老师露出了一副完全抛弃了现世的面孔。

en.t: At that moment, the teacher showed a face that seemed to have completely cast off the present world.

units.source_text: 生活的细节、金钱、女人和所有的一切，他都-一染指了，他这样一副污辱现世的面孔，是我从未曾见过的……

en.t: The details of life, money, women, and everything else, he had sullied his hands with every one of them; such a face, as though insulting the present world, was something I had never seen before...

units.source_text: 我感到厌恶，仿佛触摸到血色好、有体温的尸体。

en.t: I felt revulsion, as if I had touched a corpse with a healthy color and body warmth.
